bioanalytical_method: Radioactivity measurement of weighed blood samples with a gamma-counter (89Zr); pharmacokinetic parameters fitted in GraphPad Prism 9.0
bioanalytical_quote: Blood samples were collected from orbital vein at 1, 3, 5, 10, 15, 20, 30, 45 min and 1, 1.5, 2, 3, 4, 14, 24, 48, 72, 96 h, and measured by a γ-counter after weighing.
notes: PK is reported for (89Zr, Mn)-WPMNs only. The body reports two half-lives with non-standard phase names: 'metabolic half-life' 0.1234 h and 'distribution half-life' 1.554 h. Note the naming is inverted relative to the usual convention - here the faster value is called metabolic and the slower value distribution - and the paper never uses the words 'elimination' or 'terminal'. Both values are therefore recorded verbatim in half_life with half_life_phase 'unspecified', and half_life_absorption and half_life_elimination are left 'not reported' rather than mapping the slow phase onto elimination. Dosing was intravenous, so no absorption phase exists. Both are stated as half-lives in hours, not rate constants. No error terms, Cmax, tmax or AUC are reported for the blood PK; the reported concentrations elsewhere are biodistribution %ID/g at fixed timepoints (liver 39.43 ± 10.03 %ID/g, spleen 25.19 ± 0.43 %ID/g at 24 h). Group size for the PK cohort is not stated. Two different 89Zr physical half-lives appear in the body for context ('89Zr (1/2t=78.4 h)' in the INTRO); the abstract's 100.8 h value was not used. The WL12-SH amino-acid sequence is not printed in the body and the PEPLIFE2 header sequence field is blank, so sequence is 'not reported'. Anaesthetics (isoflurane, 4% chloral hydrate) and the 808 nm laser irradiation are procedural interventions and are not listed as agents.
